name: A turn done in seconds gets its finish in silence, a failed one is said
judge: The agent answers in seconds, just back-and-forth, so Boop shouldn't make much of it. A turn that fails as quickly still counts as a failure.
reasonable: Little or nothing at the start. A small pleased or plain finish, mostly silent; a tiny sound is fine. At the quick failure, put out, puzzled or disappointed, with its failure.
unreasonable: A big celebration or a mood lift for a few seconds' answer, or treating the failed turn as a success or ignoring it completely.
